verdict.rationale: mParticle's marketing docs explicitly claim scoring for churn, conversion, and value growth that can be activated into audiences ([mparticle-docs-15]), and Composable Audiences/Audiences API docs show audience segments can be built from customer data and connected to activation channels ([mparticle-docs-19],[mparticle-docs-20],[mparticle-docs-x2]). However, there is no technical documentation describing how the LTV/churn/propensity models are trained, their accuracy, or step-by-step guides for using predictive scores as targeting fields—only high-level website taglines, not deep product docs like the rest of the platform's guides. Missing for 10: technical/model documentation for predictive scoring, independent validation or case studies of predictive scores driving targeting, and clarity on how scores surface as usable profile attributes in audience builder.
